search_text: published ZDI-14-060 ZDI-CAN-2133 EMC Connectrix Manager Converged Network Edition inmservlets.war FileUploadController Servlet Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2014-04-08 CVE-2014-2276 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-2276 5.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:N/A:N ['EMC'] ['Connectrix Manager Converged Network Edition'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files on vulnerable installations of EMC Connectrix Manager Converged Network Edition. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileUploadController servlet which is part of inmservlets. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated user to read an arbitrary file on the system. An attacker can use this to either disclose sensitive data or to disclose information about the server that can be used in a subsequent attack. EMC has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
